title: Twee 3 / CI pipeline integration contract: tt3.config.json + shell adapter
purpose: Concrete integration contract showing how the Twine (Twee 3) VS Code extension's build interface (tt3.config.json + Tweego) maps onto a generic CI pipeline. Includes a minimal tt3.config.json, a POSIX shell adapter invoking Tweego, and a passage-tag contract table. Documented as a design sample; not installed or executed.
